docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $400.00 FILED BY BINSTOCK JEFFREY AS TO DEFENDANT AMPCO PARKING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JUN-14-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 00
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL
CERT. RECEIPT TO THOMAS BARRETT (AMPCO PARKING) RETURNED SIGNED.
